capabilities: generate a word cloud from a word list via the command palette or a wordcloud code block
click or tap any word to center it and redistribute the rest of the cloud
customize colors, fonts, spacing, separators, and text casing
auto-scale font sizes and spacing based on word count
extras: README documents performance limits (up to 100 words smooth, 200+ not recommended) and notes there is no ribbon icon on mobile due to an Obsidian mobile limitation.
motivation: The author was inspired by Ray Bradbury's essay in Zen in the Art of Writing, which describes making lists of evocative nouns as provocations for creative discovery, and wanted to bring that technique into Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize a list of words or themes as an interactive word cloud inside a note.
summary: Word cloud generator that renders word lists as interactive clouds with random sizes, colors, and rotations, inserted via command or code block.
